stuck.title: Car stuck
stuck.about: Places on drivable streets where the drive check's car (0.9 m either side of the centre line, every 2 m) is stopped by a building, water, a railing, a wall, a post or the map's edge, or stands off a bridge deck, and a car shifted across the street (a quarter metre at a time, staying 0.9 m inside its mapped width) is stopped too. Size is the length of street blocked. Off service roads it blocks the way (3); on a service road it is 2. Where only the car on the centre line is stopped and a car to one side passes, the line runs close to a wall and the place is minor (1). Not listed: 46 places where a street ends at what it leads to (a driveway at its house, a slipway at the shore): no other drivable way of the map's records goes on from the street's end, the car is stopped by a building or the water at most 2 samples from it, and the street's line runs no more than 0.3 m into the building (1.5 m into the water). 15 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-drive.json (2026-11-28 03:12).

lane.title: Car hits something in its lane
lane.about: Places where a car driving in its lane (every street each way, a quarter of its width right of its middle, every half metre, with the car's body as in the game) meets something solid: a building, a wall, a post, the water (knock); and junctions where a turn's curve from one street into another does (corner: minor where a tighter, wider or outer line gets round, else 2). A street's free end at what it leads to (a driveway at its garage, a slipway) is not one. Size is the length of lane hit; from 3 m off a service road it is clearly visible (3). Listed: every corner, knocks of a metre or more or off service roads; the others are counted. (scripts/sources/audit_lanes.cjs) 50 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-lanes.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

ghost.title: Building with no collision
ghost.about: Drawn buildings more than 2.5 m high that have no collision: a car or the drone passes straight through. A metre counts when there is no collision at its middle nor 0.15 m to each side of it (the collision's outlines are stored to 0.15 m). Size is the area; from 20 m² it is clearly visible (3). From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

drive_through.title: Car drives through a building
drive_through.about: Buildings whose drawn walls stand on the ground while the collision behind them is open below (no part a car meets within 2.3 m of the ground for 1.5 m into the building): a car drives through the wall into it. Canopies and buildings raised as a whole are meant to be open below and are left out. One place per building, from 2 m of such wall; size is the building's footprint, from 20 m² it is clearly visible (3), else 2. From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

invisible.title: Invisible wall
invisible.about: Collision more than 2 m above the ground where nothing is drawn: a car or a walker hits thin air. A metre counts when nothing is drawn at its middle nor 0.15 m to each side of it. The hand-built landmarks (Näsinneula) count as drawn. From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

too_high.title: Collision above a roof
too_high.about: Collision more than 4 m above the drawn roof: the drone is stopped in the air over a low roof. Cars and walkers do not notice, so these are minor. From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

under_deck.title: Not on its bridge deck
under_deck.about: Lamps, street things and trees mapped on a bridge that do not stand on its deck: under it, in it or floating over it (the collision check, audit_solids.cjs). From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46). None at the last check.

no_street.title: Bare ground in a street
no_street.about: Where the map's ground is a street (a road, tram line, car park or path) but bare ground is drawn: visible (2), clearly from 20 m² (3). Not listed: driveways (the map's service roads the city's street survey does not have) are painted on the ground by design, 1,791,543 m² at the last check. Not listed: 238 hairline places (1,444 m²), bare ground only along a drawn street's edge, every metre within 0.35 m of it and painted in the street's own colour: the seam between the ground layer's and the drawn street's copies of one outline, not a missing street. It goes at the source in the next map rebuild. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

off_street.title: Street drawn off the ground
off_street.about: A car street or bridge drawn more than 0.6 m above or below where a car stands on it: the car sinks into it or floats over it. From 1 m off it is clearly visible (3). From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

jolt.title: Bump the drawing does not show
jolt.about: Places on car streets (within a drivable street's mapped width, every half metre from above) where the level a car stands on steps by more than 6 cm between two neighbouring half metres while the drawn street steps by less than 3 cm: the car jolts over a bump the picture does not show, as where a kerb is kept on the street heights' metre cells inside a lane. Size is the length of the step; visible (2) from 1 m, clearly (3) from 5 m with a step of 10 cm or more (the car's own kerb bump, src/vehicle.ts). Listed from 1 m; shorter ones are counted. 28 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

rough.title: Rough street
rough.about: 20 m pieces of a lane rougher than 20 m/km as the International Roughness Index measures it (the level a car stands on every quarter metre, a standard quarter car at 80 km/h; a smooth city street rates 2 to 6), or with a single step of 10 cm or more. Visible (2), on a service road minor (most of the list: driveways and yards on the ground as it is); clearly (3) from 100 m/km or a step of half a metre. Size is the piece's length. Listed off service roads or where the car is thrown; the others are counted. (scripts/sources/audit_lanes.cjs) At the last check the lanes rated 7.84 m/km on average, 1,094.96 km of 3,390.3 rougher than 6. 54 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-lanes.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

level.title: Car off the drawn street
level.about: Places on car streets where the street is drawn 8 cm to 0.6 m above where a car stands (it sinks into the picture) or below it (it floats over it); beyond 0.6 m it is a street drawn off the ground. Size is the area; visible (2) from 2 m² or 20 cm off, else minor. Listed from 1 m²; smaller ones are counted. 19 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

off_path.title: Path drawn off the ground
off_path.about: A path or footbridge drawn more than 0.6 m above or below where a walker stands on it. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

holes.title: Hole in the ground
holes.about: Nothing drawn at all: the sky shows through the ground (water left out). From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46). None at the last check.

see_through.title: See-through from the street
see_through.about: Views from a street at eye height (every 50 m along every street, both ways) where more than 40 pixels of sky show below the horizon. Size counts the views. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46). None at the last check.

back_faces.title: Faces seen from behind
back_faces.about: Views from a street at eye height (every 50 m along every street, both ways) showing more than 30 pixels (of 320 x 160) of faces from behind, trees and grass blades left out: the game's shading pass draws front faces only, so it sees through them and draws what lies behind over them (Hämeensilta's floor was seen through so). Visible (2) from 300 pixels, else minor. Listed from 100 pixels; the others are counted. 9 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-inspect.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

ground_gaps.title: Light under a wall
ground_gaps.about: A wall's foot standing 0.15 to 2.3 m above what holds it (the ground, or the water's surface at a shore) with nothing drawn below: a slit of light under a building. One place per building; size is the length of wall. Visible (2) where the gap reaches 0.5 m, else minor. 8 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-solids.json (2026-11-28 02:46).

unrecorded.title: Unrecorded ground
unrecorded.about: Ground no record we hold says anything of: no ground area, no building standing on it, no water and no road line. The game paints it in its own flat pale colour, not lawn, and grows no grass on it. Pieces in 4 m cells cut on the map's squares, strips under about 8 m wide left out; each piece of 10,000 m² or more is listed and every piece of 500 m² or more counted. The detail names the record we hold that could draw most of it, or says that none does and why. Visible (2) from 5,000 m² inside the city limit, else minor (scripts/sources/audit_unrecorded.py). At the last check 9,730 ha inside the city limit (18% of its land) and 4,680 ha on the map's squares beyond it were unrecorded; a record we hold could draw 156 ha of that inside the limit. 376 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-unrecorded.json (2026-11-27 15:05).

data_gaps.title: Missing source data
data_gaps.about: What a download area's sources have none of, as a box over the area's squares: declared per area in cities/source-lacks.json, declared by the city's adapter for what its records never hold, or where the city's 3D building model has no buildings. Size is the area's squares on the map.

osmose.title: OpenStreetMap errors
osmose.about: Errors in OpenStreetMap itself, the source of the map's streets, buildings and land, as Osmose (osmose.openstreetmap.fr) finds them every day: only the kinds that change what the game draws or how its ways meet (a street through a building or water, levels of a bridge or tunnel that do not join, streets mapped twice or cut off, areas that cannot be closed). Fix them in OpenStreetMap from the Osmose page the detail names, never in the build: the next extract brings the fix. Each is one place of size 1; visible (2) where the game draws it wrong, else minor (scripts/sources/osmose.py, asked of Osmose by hand). Osmose was asked on 2026-11-27. 255 lie beyond the city limit and count as minor. From reports/tampere-osmose.json (2026-11-27 21:21).
